# The Knight Ryders

> The Knight Ryders is a group bike riding community in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, for Honda CB350 owners. The club organises weekend rides, long-distance touring rides and social-cause rides ("Ride for the Cause"), and has completed 90+ group rides covering over 50,000 km with 170+ riders.

## About
- Type: motorcycle / bike riding club and community
- Bike focus: Honda CB350 (H'ness CB350) owners
- Based in: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Website: https://theknightryders.com
- WhatsApp: +91 6381 890 182
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theknightryders/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/theknightryders
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TheKnightRyders1

## Key pages
- [About the club](https://theknightryders.com/about): who we are and what we do
- [Upcoming rides](https://theknightryders.com/rides/upcoming): scheduled group rides and how to join
- [Past rides](https://theknightryders.com/rides/past): ride stories, routes, photos and stats from every ride
- [Sign up](https://theknightryders.com/signup): request to join the community
- [Festivals](https://theknightryders.com/festivals): festival greeting cards from the club

## Common questions
- How do I join a group bike riding community in Chennai? Sign up on the website; a club admin approves membership. Questions can be sent on WhatsApp.
- Who can join? Honda CB350 owners and riders who want to ride with the group.
- How do I find the next ride? See the upcoming rides page, where members can request to join each ride.
